_comment: Every claim the site makes, with its status. docs/reality.md and the status tables on the pages are generated from this file by admin/build/gen_features.py. shipped means it exists in the repository, runs, and has been exercised; proposed means it is designed (the brief says how) and not built; absent means it is deliberately not in the MVP. A shipped row carries the version that shipped it. rulesHash is the SHA-256 of rulesSource; the gate fails when they disagree. Every claim carries evidence: typed edges (verb, to) to the intent it realises, the files it lives in, the test or check that proves it, the section or document that describes it, the URL where it is seen; review/tools/claims.py turns them into the claims layer of the review graph and fails the build when a shipped claim has no anchor that resolves.

statuses.shipped: exists in the repository, runs, and was exercised at the version shown
statuses.proposed: designed in the brief, not built; described only in the future tense
statuses.absent: deliberately not in the MVP; comes as a later version or a later site, or never
